methodSource.says: Size guide for tops, rows "Chest inch", "Waist inch", "Arm length inch" and "Neckline inch", beside US suit sizes ("38R-40R" for M). Its How to measure panel was not read; the chest is recorded as a body circumference from the chart's rows and values, and that reading needs checking.

sources.what: product page: sizes offered, Size guide (Regular: XS-M, L-XXL, 3XL tabs), description and material

notes: The size guide is H&M's general guide for tops, shirts, jackets and blazers, opened from this product's page; it is not specific to this T-shirt.
H&M publishes no garment measurements for this product, so its length, sleeve, shoulder and garment chest are unknown.
The guide's Long sizes (XS/L - 3XL/L) share the Regular chest ranges with longer arm lengths; arm length and neckline are body measurements the schema does not hold yet, and are not recorded.
"Regular fit" describes this product only; other H&M T-shirts are sold as slim, relaxed and oversized.
